basic_info.description: Urban Edge Meets Cozy Comfort at 1133B Filbert St    Welcome to your city hideaway in one of SF's hottest neighborhoods. Nestled in the iconic 94109 recently ranked #5 hottest real estate market in the U.S. This one-bed, one-bath Russian Hill gem brings modern character and unmistakable SF charm.    Concrete and hardwood floors add texture & style, while an oversized window fills the bright living room with natural light. Ideal for recharging, entertaining, or just soaking up the city vibe.    The kitchen? Clean, functional, and fitted with brand-new appliances. Perfect for weekday fuel-ups or hosting weekend dinner parties. Bonus: in-unit laundry. Yes, adulting just got easier. Street parking keeps things flexible but with downtown, Polk Gulch eats, nightlife, and your office all within close distance, you might ditch the car altogether. 1133 B Filbert isn't just a home it's your springboard into everything San Francisco. Comfortable, stylish, and located to win.
